pages.title: Eremotherium
pages.text: The Eremotherium ($(o)Eremotherium laurillardi$()) is an extinct giant ground sloth that lived across the tropical and subtropical Americas during the Pleistocene, from the southern United States to Brazil.$(br2)It rivalled its close relative Megatherium in size, making it one of the largest ground sloths ever.$(br2)Eremotherium was a browser that used its great height and long, curved claws to pull down leaves and branches.
